messages.content: Describe a small disagreement with someone who trained you.
I sometimes had to refuse a command while keeping my voice polite. It was difficult, because I was used to being respected. A small gesture of refusing authority was not the same as losing my job.
Would that person remember it the same way now?
Often not. They might remember that I had done something unexpected. What mattered to me was that I could work through the difficulty without pretending that I had agreed.
